mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports recent King main thrust bearings measuring out of spec, slipping into the cap and block grooves too easily with no proper interference fit, creating a risk of spinning the thrust bearing. The snippet states King technical support confirmed they would not recommend using them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.
